name: GHLImportBugFix-Batch3-CompanyName-2026-05-20
observations: Incident: Batch 3 of Vegas pool leads (30 contacts, see VegasPoolLeads-Batch3-2026-05-20) appeared to import with blank Company Name fields after the GHL CSV wizard Pass 1. Triggered the GHL IMPORT WIZARD — MAPPING DRIFT LANDMINE protocol in CLAUDE.md.

First remediation: Generated a 2-column patch CSV (Phone E.164 + Company Name) and ran GHL 'Update existing contacts' import mode matching on Phone. After import, opened Bob Jones (702-294-1759) and Saya Pools (725-305-2802) contact cards. Company Name still appeared blank in the header view — interpreted as a second failure.

Diagnostic loop attempted via GHL MCP: search_contacts, get_object_schema, get_all_objects all returned HTTP 401 'token is not authorized for this scope'. The MCP token has workflow/pipeline write scopes but no contact-read scope — diagnostic loop hit a hard auth blocker before root cause could be confirmed via API.

Actual root cause discovered by manual UI inspection: GHL contact card displays Company Name in the 'General Info' section, NOT in the contact card header. The patch import HAD populated Company Name correctly on the first attempt — the verification step was looking in the wrong UI zone.

Resolution verified 2026-05-20: Bob Jones contact shows 'Bob Jones Pool Service & Repair' under General Info. Cory Gorman (the 1 phone-less contact, manually edited in UI per CONTACTS WITHOUT PHONE OR EMAIL procedure) shows 'NO Worries Pool Care' under General Info. All 30 batch 3 contacts confirmed populated.

Open question: Whether the original Pass 1 import actually dropped the Company Name field, or whether Pass 1 also populated General Info correctly and the entire 'wizard drift' diagnosis was UI-zone confusion. Cannot retroactively confirm without snapshots. The 2-PASS IMPORT PATTERN stays mandatory as cheap insurance (2 min cost, eliminates ambiguity).

Wizard label aliasing observation: GHL CSV wizard offered 'Business Name' as the suggested mapping for the Company Name column during Pass 2. 'Business Name' and 'Company Name' appear to write to the same underlying contact field — confirmed by the General Info display reading the patched data.

Cost of incident: ~2 hours debugging a patch that worked the first time. Plus a stop-everything diagnostic loop that would not have resolved via MCP (auth-blocked) and required manual UI verification to close.
Unblocks: Batch 3 leads (30 contacts) are now ready for the Pool Email Campaign workflow once the pool-email-campaign gatekeeper tag is applied (per CLAUDE.md GATEKEEPER TAG ARCHITECTURE).
Files affected: memory/leads/vegas-pool-leads-batch-3-company-patch.csv (the 2-column patch file used), memory/leads/vegas-pool-leads-batch-3-ghl-ready.csv (the original import file).

name: GHL-Contact-Card-Field-Display-Locations
observations: GHL contact card UI splits standard fields across multiple display zones. The header area shows the contact name, tags, primary identifiers. The General Info section, further down the card, shows Company Name, Address, and secondary contact info. Custom fields render in their own zone(s) below General Info.
Company Name does NOT display in the contact card header. It only displays in the General Info section. Seeing no Company Name in the header is NOT evidence that the field is blank.

Forward rule: Before declaring any GHL field empty after an import, update, or workflow write, OPEN the contact in the UI, SCROLL past the header, and check the General Info section AND the custom fields section. Apply this rule to Company Name first since that is the specific field that bit us.

Wizard label aliasing rule: GHL's CSV import wizard sometimes presents field names ('Business Name') that do not visually match the contact card label ('Company Name'). Treat wizard labels as suggestions. Post-import spot-check is the only authoritative confirmation that the write landed in the right field.

Diagnostic-tool blind spot: The GHL MCP token in this codespace currently lacks contact-read scopes (search_contacts, get_object_schema, get_all_objects all return 401). Means a remote diagnostic loop cannot replace manual UI verification when the symptom is 'field appears blank.' Future re-auth should add contacts.readonly, locations/customFields.readonly, and objects.readonly scopes.
Cost: ~2 hours on 2026-05-20 plus a stop-everything diagnostic loop. Entirely avoidable if the General Info section had been checked on the first verification pass.

Forward rule for ROCCO: When the user says 'a GHL field is blank after a write,' the FIRST instruction back is 'open the contact, scroll to General Info, screenshot that zone.' Do not propose remediation writes until visual confirmation of the actual blank state is in hand.

Belongs in skills/lessons-learned.md as the next L-NNN ledger entry (currently next ID is L-019 after L-018). Not yet appended to that file — separate edit required for ROCCO's §4 anti-pattern cheat scan to surface this rule at session start.
Related: GHLImportBugFix-Batch3-CompanyName-2026-05-20 (the incident this lesson came from).
